notes.title: Ver.1.3s3 Update
notes.notes:
Updated for more comfortable playing.

[list]
[*] Hide the mouse cursor when recognizing the gamepad.
[*] Corresponded to vibration when using the Xbox One controller.
[/list]

We will continue to update. Thanks.

notes.title: EXIT button update
notes.notes:
You can close the game from the EXIT button on the top screen.
In other words, you don't have to put a pad to press Esc key.
We didn't consider enough, because we are a console development team. Sorry.
We will continue to update. Thanks.

notes.title: Update for monitors other than 60 Hz
notes.notes:
Fixed a problem that did not work properly on monitors other than 60 Hz.
At startup, "Graphics quality" can be set according to the monitor environment.

We’ll keep checking the forums after the update goes live. 
Thanks for your awesome support!
